why_agent_cannot: log in or create the account (human session)
what_human_must_do: Log in / create the account in the shared profile, then the agent can continue.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Open the Project 0 app Go to the Project 0 app , which opens on a Markets page with Lend and Unified Borrow views.
2 Step 2 : Read the welcome tutorial The app has a short welcome tutorial. It explains unified margin and how Project 0 treats positions across venues as one portfolio.
3 Step 3 : Open the Wallet section Open the Wallet section of the app, found on the Markets page .
4 Step 4 : Browse a lending market Open a market such as SOL to see its APY, weight and total deposits before you decide to use it.
5 Step 5 : Look at the SOL Vault The SOL Vault on the Markets page is described as automated LST yield for SOL deposits. Check the vault's APY and deposit details in the app before depositing.
